title: Tech Note: A different way to display data

historical_commentary.text: The specific classic-4D drawing techniques this note likely demonstrated have been superseded by modern charting/visualization libraries (including JS-based charting embedded in web areas), but the core data-visualization design principle it champions — that visual presentation affects comprehension — remains entirely valid and is a mainstay of contemporary UX/data-viz practice.
related_updates: Modern 4D web areas can embed contemporary JS charting/visualization libraries, offering far richer options than the classic drawing techniques available in 2003
